paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в средните абсолютни стойности на скритите състояния (hidden states) през различните слоеве на модела, като сравнява три конфигурации. Заглавието на фигурата е „Hidden State Mean". Оста X е обозначена като „Layer", със скала от линеен тип, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, с етикети, разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, с етикети, разположени през интервали от 1.0 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия, представена в син цвят с пунктиран стил (dashed), е обозначена в легендата като „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя не използва видими маркери. От слой 0 до приблизително слой 5 стойностите се увеличават леко до около 0.2–0.3. Между слоеве 5 и 10 линията остава относително стабилна около 0.2. След слой 10 започва постепенно нарастване, като около слой 12–13 стойностите достигат приблизително 0.4–0.5. От слой 15 нататък нарастването става значително по-стръмно, като стойностите достигат около 0.5 при слой 15, около 0.9 при слой 17–18, и след това рязко се покачват до приблизително 2.6 при слой 21 и достигат връх от около 2.6–2.8 при последния видим слой (около слой 23). Наблюдава се лек спад между слоеве 21 и 22, последван от повторно покачване.

Втората линия, представена в оранжев цвят с точков (dotted) стил, е обозначена като „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон на оста X, от слой 0 до слой 23, без видими значителни отклонения или върхове. Стойностите изглеждат постоянно под 0.1.

Третата линия, представена в зелен цвят с плътен (solid) стил, е обозначена като „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Подобно на оранжевата линия, тя остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон от слой 0 до слой 23. В последните слоеве (приблизително от слой 20 до 23) се забелязва минимално увеличение, като стойностите достигат приблизително 0.08–0.1, което я прави леко по-висока от оранжевата линия в тази зона. Легендата е разположена в горната лява част на фигурата.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 1.0 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Three lines are plotted. The first, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," is a blue dashed line that starts near 0 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 2 through 7, then dips back toward approximately 0.1 around layer 10. From layer 10 onward it begins increasing, reaching roughly 0.4–0.5 around layer 15, then accelerates sharply, climbing to approximately 0.9 near layer 18, then to about 2.2 at layer 21, with a brief dip around layer 22 before rising steeply to approximately 2.6 at layer 23. The second line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," is an orange dotted line that remains very close to 0 across all layers, staying below approximately 0.1 throughout the entire range from layer 0 to layer 23. The third line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," is a green solid line that also remains very close to 0 across all layers, with a very slight increase visible in the final layers reaching roughly 0.1 at layer 23, but otherwise nearly indistinguishable from the orange dotted line for most of the layer range.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three different configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to approximately 23 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and ranges from 0 to approximately 4.5 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1.0. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents the "hidden state mean before gate" with a reported average of 0.71. This line starts near 0 at layer 0, rises slightly to approximately 0.2–0.3 around layers 3–7, then dips back slightly around layer 10 before beginning a steep upward trajectory from around layer 12 onward, reaching approximately 0.5 near layer 15, approximately 0.9 near layer 18, and then climbing sharply to roughly 2.6 at layer 22 and approximately 2.5 at layer 23, with a notable spike to around 4.3 visible near layer 21. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents the "hidden state mean after gate" with a reported average of 0.05. This line remains very close to zero throughout all layers, with values barely distinguishable from the x-axis, showing only a very slight increase in the final layers to approximately 0.05–0.1. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents the "hidden state mean of baseline" with a reported average of 0.04. This line similarly remains near zero across all layers, with a slight upward trend in the later layers reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23, appearing marginally above the orange dotted line in the final few layers.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt den mittleren Absolutwert von Hidden States über die Schichten eines Modells hinweg und vergleicht dabei drei Konfigurationen: vor dem Gate, nach dem Gate und eine Baseline. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, ebenfalls linear skaliert, und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie repräsentiert den Hidden-State-Mittelwert vor dem Gate (Durchschnitt 0,71); sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,2 bis 0,3 im Bereich der Layer 3 bis 7, fällt dann leicht zurück auf etwa 0,1 bei Layer 10, bevor sie ab Layer 12 deutlich ansteigt – auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 15, dann auf ungefähr 0,9 bei Layer 18, weiter auf circa 2,2 bei Layer 20 und erreicht einen Spitzenwert von etwa 2,6 bis 2,8 bei Layer 22–23, wobei ein kurzer Rückgang zwischen Layer 21 und 22 sichtbar ist. Die orange gepunktete Linie repräsentiert den Hidden-State-Mittelwert nach dem Gate (Durchschnitt 0,05); sie verläuft über alle Schichten hinweg nahe bei null, beginnend bei etwa 0 bei Layer 0 und bleibt durchgehend unter 0,1, mit einem leichten Anstieg in den letzten Schichten. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie repräsentiert den Hidden-State-Mittelwert der Baseline (Durchschnitt 0,04); sie verläuft ebenfalls nahe bei null über alle Schichten, beginnend bei etwa 0 bei Layer 0, und zeigt in den letzten Schichten (ab Layer 20) einen geringfügigen Anstieg auf etwa 0,1.
